meta.title: GitKittie — Small apps built on your own git
meta.description: GitKittie makes GitKittie Folder, GitKittie Kanban and GitKittie Bud: small, local-first apps for Mac, iPhone and iPad that use your own git — GitHub, GitLab, or wherever your repositories already live. No accounts, no servers.

hero.title: Small apps, built on *your own git.*
hero.subtitle: Three focused, local-first apps that use the git setup you already have — GitHub, GitLab, or wherever your repositories live. No accounts, no servers, no lock-in.

statement.text: Your files, in your repositories, on the machines you own. GitKittie builds the small native apps that sit on top of that.

apps.title: Three apps, *one idea.*
apps.subtitle: Keep your work in plain files under git — and get a native app that makes it effortless. Pick the one you need; they share the same principles and the same engine.

items.name: GitKittie Folder
items.tagline: Version history for your folders on Mac, and your repos as folders on iPhone.
points: Automatic snapshot commits when files change
Browse and edit your repos on iPhone and iPad
Uses the GitHub or GitLab access you already have

items.name: GitKittie Kanban
items.tagline: A kanban board whose only data source is a git repo of markdown.
points: Your board is a git repo of markdown files
One file = one card; history comes from git
Agents and scripts can populate it headlessly

items.name: GitKittie Bud
items.tagline: A git client that makes rewriting history visual — and safe to undo.
points: Rebase, split, squash and reorder by pointing at commits
Every rewrite is previewed and lands on a safety ref first
Branch graph, file history and pull requests in one window

principles.title: The same promises, *in every app.*
principles.subtitle: They hold across the family because the data is always the same thing — your files, in your git.

features.title: Local-first & private
features.desc: No GitKittie account, no cloud service. Your files move directly between your device and the git host you already use.

features.title: Your own git
features.desc: The apps read and write plain git repositories you own. Nothing is locked into a proprietary format or backend.

features.title: Built on your git host
features.desc: They lean on the git configuration you already trust — the same repositories, keys and permissions, on GitHub, GitLab or anywhere else.

features.title: Native, not a web wrapper
features.desc: Small, focused apps built with SwiftUI for each platform — each does one thing well and stays out of your way.

cta.title: Own your data. *Keep owning it.*
cta.subtitle: GitKittie Folder and GitKittie Kanban are on the Mac App Store and the App Store. GitKittie Bud is in development.
